tex_content.label: noncollapsed1
tex_content.source:
\label{noncollapsed1} (cf. Definition I.4.2)
$g$ is $\kappa$-noncollapsed on scale $\rho$ if every ball of radius $r<\rho$
with $|\Rm|\le r^{-2}$ throughout has volume at least $\kappa r^n$.
\end{definition}
